summary: Clean on MEM. The Any type-erasure path is refcount-balanced and memory-safe: the meminfo's destructor is baked in at allocation time by the wrapped type (`_Content`), so it travels with the erased pointer and correctly decrefs the contained payload at finalization even though `ErasedType` has zero fields. No `@cfunc` exception boundary, no raw-pointer stores, and no dependence on numba's `removerefctpass`. The balance is independently confirmed by dedicated refcount tests (test_5/test_7/test_10).
